answer: Each identity must weekly complete three live 10-minute interrogations by random established peers codenamed lotus, falcon, and echo, answering unpredictable follow-ups about its recent trades. Sessions cannot be prerecorded because peers inject fresh nonces mid-call. One identity costs 30 minutes weekly; 1,000 Sybils need 500 distinct interactive hours weekly plus a 5-coin bond forfeited per missed or contradictory session, making scripted duplication uneconomic.
